about.title: Transparency, speed and responsible lending
about.intro: FondsLink was founded with one goal: to make personal loans simple, transparent and accessible, wherever you live.
about.missionText: We believe a financial decision should be simple. That's why we built a simulator that shows the real cost of a loan in real time, and an application form that takes under two minutes.
about.value1Text: No hidden costs or small print to catch you out.
about.value2Text: We only collect the data needed to process your application.
about.value3Text: We lend responsibly and encourage you to work out what you can afford.
about.presenceText: We operate in Slovenia, Slovakia, Lithuania, Puerto Rico, the Netherlands/Flanders and Ireland, each adapted to the local language.

footer.riskNote: A loan is a financial commitment. Carefully consider your ability to repay before signing the contract.

legal.termsP1: This document governs the terms of use of the FondsLink website (fondslink.com) and its loan simulation and application services. By using the site, you agree to these terms.
legal.termsP2: The loan simulator on the website is for information purposes only and does not constitute a binding credit offer. The actual offer depends on an individual assessment of the application.
legal.termsP3: FondsLink reserves the right to decline any loan application without stating a reason, in accordance with the applicable legislation of each country.
legal.termsP4: The content of the website is protected by copyright. Copying or distributing the content without permission is prohibited.
legal.privacyP1: FondsLink respects your privacy. The loan simulator on this site requires no personal data, and nothing is stored on our servers — the figures remain only in your browser during your session.
legal.privacyP2: Personal data (first name, last name, email, phone) that you provide through the contact form or the loan application form is used solely to process your application and is sent directly to our email. We do not store this data in a database.
legal.privacyP3: We never sell or share your data with third parties for marketing purposes.
legal.privacyP4: For any questions about data protection, contact us at podpora@fondslink.com.
legal.cookiesP1: This website uses a minimal amount of technical data stored in your browser (session storage), solely to remember the loan simulator figures (amount and term) during your visit when you move to the application form.
legal.cookiesP2: This data is automatically deleted when you close your browser and is never sent to any server.
legal.cookiesP3: The website does not use third-party tracking or advertising cookies.
